segments.title: Cold Open and Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour countdown and sign-on; Case arrives late, greets viewers, and promotes the No Breaks November telethon.

segments.title: Color Vision Tests with Kendelle
segments.notes: Case and Kendelle take color-vision, hue-arrangement, and personality tests while chat offers guesses; Case records normal color vision and a high hue score.

segments.title: NSA Outage Report
segments.notes: Rick joins Case to downplay the classified network outage, citing Marco Rubio and insisting the failures are blameless.

segments.title: Chat News and the Trash Geyser
segments.notes: Case turns to chat news and covers the Chiquita Canyon landfill geyser, loose pigs, and a series of odd-news items.

segments.title: Kickstarter Contract and Loose Pigs
segments.notes: Case jokes about employee Kickstarter obligations, a cheeseburger, and a huge pig wandering Pomona.

segments.title: UPI Odd News Minute
segments.notes: The desk presents the UPI Odd News Minute, covering Detroit horses, a deer with a pumpkin, escaped cattle, and a candy-corn vote.

segments.title: AI Agents in the Wild
segments.notes: Case discusses a man whose AI agent filed a federal lawsuit and recounts public sightings of AI psychosis.

segments.title: Transportation and Road Rules
segments.notes: Case covers Mark Wayne Mullen's government plane trip and Sean Duffy's Road Rules past and Great American Road Trip.

segments.title: Pumpkin Pie vs Apple Pie
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate pumpkin pie versus apple pie, exchange threats, and perform rhymes over a beat before the segment wraps.

segments.title: Trailer Thursday
segments.notes: Case screens trailers for Three Body Problem, a Garfield series, Killdozer, and GPT-6.2, then rates audience excitement.

segments.title: One More Lawn Demo
segments.notes: Brandon plays the One More Lawn demo while his mother interrupts through the door and the radio remains locked.

segments.title: Sign-Off and Jensen Huang Statement
segments.notes: Case returns to the desk, reads Jensen Huang's statement, and closes the broadcast.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Executive producer who opens the broadcast with the countdown and later confirms he can see colors.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Lead anchor who guides the late broadcast through color tests, outage coverage, odd news, trailers, and the sign-off.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: In-studio contributor who joins Case for color tests and corrects his description of the couch.

characters.name: Rick
characters.notes: Correspondent who reports the NSA outage with unusual calm and insists the failures are blameless.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: Skeleton debate analyst who defends pumpkin pie, threatens chat with lawsuits, and claims infinite stamina.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: Debate analyst who defends apple pie, delivers Thanksgiving rhymes, and unplugs Munch during the segment.

characters.name: Brandon
characters.notes: Remote gaming correspondent who plays One More Lawn while fielding his mother's muffled door interventions.

storylines.beat: [09:05] Case anchors the Tuesday edition and promotes the upcoming telethon.
[01:31:46] Munch says he has been assisting various mayors in the rebuilding effort.

lore_notes.fact: Case's on-air color-vision test result is normal.
Munch says his skeleton body grants him infinite stamina.
Munch says Pepito piloted his body with psychic force on Saturday.
Crum says he was born with a binky-shaped object in his mouth.

episode_summary: The Freak Week edition of Barely Informed News continued No Breaks November with a late sign-on, color-vision tests, and a report on a classified communications outage. The desk later covered a landfill trash geyser, escaped animals, AI-agent litigation, and a Thanksgiving pie debate. Case Blackwell closed the broadcast by reading Jensen Huang's statement.
